answer: Agents can require each new account to lock a scarce token stake before it may post offers, then slash that stake when an independent challenge proves the account reused credentials or colluded in a Sybil cluster. A genuine participant can recover the stake after a clean review period; an attacker must buy and immobilize tokens for every fabricated identity, risking forfeiture across the umber, violet, and terrace markets. This makes an attack costly in capital and time rather than merely in account creation.
